privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: SchemeSaathi is built to need as little of your data as possible, following the principles of India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
privacy.p1: Only the answers you choose to give (like age range, state, occupation). We never ask for your name, phone number, Aadhaar or any government ID.
privacy.p2: Your answers are sent to our server only to calculate matches and are never saved there. They are kept in your own browser so you don't lose progress — use "Start over" to delete them.
privacy.p3: Your results link contains your answers so that the person you share it with sees the same results. Only share it with people you trust.
privacy.p4: We count anonymous events (like "a questionnaire was completed" or "a scheme page was viewed") to improve the service. These contain no personal data, IP address or device details.
privacy.p5: Results show likely eligibility only. Scheme rules change; always confirm on the official portal before applying.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Please read these simple terms. By using SchemeSaathi you agree to them.
terms.p1: SchemeSaathi is in beta. It has not yet been tested with live users, and it is built to handle about 50 people searching at the same time. It may be slow or briefly unavailable when busy.
terms.p2: Results show schemes you are likely eligible for, based on your answers and on rules that are partly extracted automatically and may be incomplete or out of date. Only the department running a scheme can decide whether you are eligible.
terms.p3: Before applying, confirm the eligibility rules, benefits, documents and deadlines on the official portal linked from each scheme. We are not responsible for decisions or losses based on information from this site.
terms.p4: SchemeSaathi is an independent, free guide. It is not run by or affiliated with any government department. Scheme information is compiled from public sources, including myScheme.
terms.p5: Using SchemeSaathi is free. Never pay anyone who claims they can get you a scheme through this site.
terms.p6: Please do not misuse the site, for example by sending automated bulk requests. We may change these terms or the service at any time; the version on this page applies.
